source.title: Strabane Chronicle, 20 May 1967, p. 8 ("Tyrone rural council nominations: no contests in Omagh and Castlederg")
source.publisher: Strabane Chronicle (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Read from the Strabane Chronicle's report of the Tyrone rural nominations, 20 May 1967, p. 8.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. There were no contests: all sixteen seats were filled unopposed. The only change was in Castlegore, where E. C. H. Young took the place of the retiring Independent, J. T. Smyth. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
